dct_description_sm: Polygon feature showing the location of aquifers in the City of Abbotsford. An aquifer is an underground layer of rock that holds groundwater. Groundwater is rain or melted snow that has seeped into the ground and is held there. Aquifers can be drained by man made wells or they can flow out naturally into springs. Dataset information includes size, name, type, and location.
